title: OrderPersisted
description: Result: published by the Database Adapter's write path immediately after a successful upsert into the orders table (Design.md §13 Step J4, Decision #26). eventDetails.correlationId is set to the triggering OrderCreated's eventId — this is how the REST API Service's synchronous ?wait= reply (Decision #24, Step I4) is resolved. Distinct from events.db.orders.RowChanged, the CDC path's own output, which fires for ANY change to the table (bus-originated or not) and carries no correlationId.

orderId.description: The same orderId the triggering OrderCreated carried.

status.description: A single value today — the write path only ever publishes this event after a successful upsert (Design.md §13 Step J4); a failed write leaves the triggering command unacked for redelivery instead, so there's nothing to report as a distinct failure status yet.

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601) the upsert completed.
